reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already resolves missing, single and ranged (furthest-from-zero) amounts.

duplication.why: No logic copied; one helper call.

placement.why: The field is attached in the api/schedules-get handler on top of scheduleModel.toExternal with a dedicated list type, which scopes it to the list as asked but puts entity mapping in the handler rather than the API model layer.

scope.why: Only the list handler, its result type, existing test expectations and a release note.

maintainability.why: The rule stays in getScheduledAmount and the separate APIScheduleListEntity type keeps the output-only field off the create/update entity.
